Bids and Tenders

Doing business with the Municipality of Kincardine

Through the province's Municipal Modernization Program, our procurement policy was reviewed for compliance with legislation, and for the provision of recommendations to modernize the procurement framework and practices. These actions help reduce costs and to streamline processes. 

The complete review can be found in the Procurement Policy and Review Report.

Bidder Documents

  • Purchasing and Procurement Policy
  • Contractor Safety Policy
  • Contractor Health and Safety Agreement - Appendix A
  • Contractor Qualification Checklist - Appendix B
  • WSIB Clearance Certificate Procedure

 

2026 Notice of Participation

This annual Notice of Participation is to advise potential suppliers that the Municipality of Kincardine plans to conduct a procurement process as described below.

Details:

Period: January 1 – December 31, 2026

Group Purchasing Participation:

  • Local Authority Services (LAS) 
  • The County of Bruce
  • Ministry of Public Business and Service Delivery Vendor of Record (VOR) Program
  • Ontario Education Collaborative Marketplace (OECM)
  • Kinetic GPO
  • Canoe Procurement Group of Canada
  • Canadian Collaborative Procurement Initiative

2026 Notice of Participation

View our Purchase Order Terms and Conditions.

Bids, Tenders, and Awards

  • Expression of Interest CS-2025-12 - Airport Operations, Maintenance and Partnership Opportunities

    The Municipality of Kincardine is seeking Expressions of Interest from interested parties to support the continued operation and long-term success of the Kincardine Municipal Airport.
    Jul 07, 2026
  • Request for Proposals - ES 2026-9476 - BEC Lagoon Outfall Replacement

    The Municipality of Kincardine is seeking tenders from qualified contractors for the Bruce Energy Centre Lagoon Outfall Replacement, including approximately 315 metres of 450 mm diameter sanitary sewer and associated works.
    Jun 04, 2026
  • Request for Proposals - ES 2026-9093 - Riggin Crescent Watermain Lining

    The Municipality of Kincardine is seeking tenders from qualified contractors for watermain lining and associated infrastructure improvements on Riggin Crescent.
    Jun 04, 2026
  • Request for Tenders ES 2026-9500-2 - Kincardine Water Treatment Plant Capacity Upgrades Project

    The Municipality of Kincardine is seeking proposals from qualified contractors for the expansion and upgrade of the Kincardine Water Treatment Plant.
    Apr 23, 2026
  • Request for Tenders ES 2026-9500-1 - In-line Booster Pump Station and Water Main Extension

    The Municipality of Kincardine is seeking proposals for construction of a new booster pump station, watermain extension, and related water distribution system upgrades.
    Apr 22, 2026

For after hours emergencies, please call 519-396-3468 and listen to the prompts. For after hours water issues, please call 519-396-4660.

In the event of an emergency, please call 9-1-1 for Police, Fire, and Emergency Services. Call 1-226-910-1322 ext. 0 for 24-hour By-Law Enforcement services for the Municipality of Kincardine. South Bruce O.P.P. can be reached at 1-888-310-1122 for non-emergency issues.
